areas.name: Public safety
areas.reason: Clear fit with organized-crime asset-recovery units; SMART indicators, viable targets; about half of resources; high but not exceptional impact; efficient but not highly innovative.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Geoprocessing unit for environmental crime monitoring fits well; SMART indicators; only about 10% of resources, so moderate impact despite replicability.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Modernization of case-handling systems tied to the area; one key indicator; roughly a quarter of resources; moderate impact, replicable, not highly innovative.

areas.name: Justice
areas.reason: Integrated data platform across justice and security bodies fits the area; two indicators; about 10% of resources; moderate impact, replicable.

bonus.reason: Proponent did not state the programme is exclusively aimed at federal PPA priorities.
Proponent did not state the programme promotes regional integration.
